commit.message:
feat(post): emit Agie straight cutoffs with separate air endpoints

Check the retained wall, kerf side, air approaches and centered XY travel. Require the operator to clamp both pieces through all QN2 passes. Keep closed work on its existing nominal cycle.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2962

feat(post): group two captured Agie punches on one piece

Validate each retained source, pierced lead and swept cut against its partner. Bind the two geometry resources and work points in one atomic native controller job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2961

test(post): exercise both native Agie cutoff compensation sides

Both source selections now travel in positive X. Pin the independent left and right native work types and the two start points on each job.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Fixes #2962
Merge branch 'issue/2962-agie-straight-cutoff' into issue/2961-agie-multiple-works

feat(wire): post a placed DXF racetrack with native Agie arcs

Prove the tangent capsule from the source lines and semicircles. Check its through-stock punch with a circumscribed preview, track source and placement changes, and write the nominal circular caps with the resident wire compensation.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2022

feat(wire): post a source DXF circle with native arc separation

Check the whole circular punch and its radial entry. Export the two nominal semicircles and leave the qualified 1 mm circular separation and wire offsets to the controller.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2022

feat(wire): qualify cardinal DXF circle entries and bounded radii

Check the exact radial line through the threading hole. Use the original center and diameter at 6 to 15 mm radius for the qualified 1 mm circular separation.

Co-Authored-By: Codex <noreply@openai.com>

Refs #2022

Merge #2969 port (30e6c4c3f) into the straight cutoff port

Move the open cut onto the zero-step setup writer of #2984. The new
agie_setup::CutoffSetup20 writes c_left or c_right, stp1 and stp2 in air,
no separation and ASDELETE only. export_with_review routes an open job to
cutoff::prepare. A closed cycle keeps the 1.0 mm separation rule.

Refs #2962

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(skill): name the open cutoff in the camcraft-mcp Wire Contour row

Refs #2962

fix(app): list the cutoff declarations in the Wire Contour MCP fields

list_operation_types now names both_pieces_restrained and
stock_centered_in_xy_travel. The remaining test constructors state both
fields.

Refs #2962

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge #2969 port (d3443eddc) into the straight cutoff port

Keep the agie_setup split into piece.rs and cutoff.rs beside main's
inspection.rs and publish.rs. The inspection writer takes attribute_call
and checked from piece.rs; its output does not change. The skill row and
the guide put the open cutoff beside the reentrant and die text, with the
20 mm offset row.

Refs #2962

fix(app): state the cutoff declarations in the sketch-chain wire constructor

Main added a Wire Contour constructor for a sketch chain (a die). It
states both new fields as false.

Refs #2962

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge #2972 (f99a9d736) into issue/2961-agie-multiple-works

Port the punch group onto the zero-step setup writer of #2984.
The old script writer (jescript.rs) is gone. The piece writer in
agie_setup/piece.rs now writes one quality, one group and a loop of
works CUT1..n. A new PunchGroup20 encodes two captured punches, each
with its own ISO stem and start hole. The post export
export_group_with_review keeps the single-work path and bytes.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(decisions): port the #2961 punch group onto the zero-step writer

Merge #2974 into the placed DXF punch: native arcs on the zero-step setup

Port #2978 onto the #2984 zero-step writer and the #3180 selected-chain
wire path. A selected DXF circle or racetrack chain gives the generator a
circumscribed polygon, and the native post writes G03 arcs with exact I/J
centres beside the CCSEP20 punch setup.

Refs #2022

The review asked for a reason for the new top-level test binary
agie_cutoff_setup, or for a move into an existing suite. The four tests
move unchanged into agie_safe_setup as the module cutoff (a #[path]
module, as agie_native does). The suite has 12 tests: 8 + 4.

Refs #2962
